names.note: The calendar’s own name page for her is «Анна (Столярова), схимонахиня, исповедница»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Прп. Анны исп». The other Anna this same day brings is «Ивашкина», a confessor of 1948 with no monastic grade. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1958)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Анны исп (1958).»

attestations.note: The last line of the day, and the latest year on it. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. «Прп.» is преподобная, which this corpus reads as `venerable`, and «исп» is исповедница, a woman confessor; her name page gives the grade the line does not — «схимонахиня», a schemanun, the great habit — and the office `Schemanun` is that word and is carried by all four locale packs. TWO ANNAS STAND ON THIS ONE DAY and the surnames tell them apart: this woman «Столярова», a schemanun of 1958, and «Ивашкина», a confessor of 1948 named with another woman on a line of her own. No folder held her: a Cyrillic grep for «Столярова» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under her name.
